title: 6BR Mesa Oasis | Pool + Mini Golf | Fall Escape
description:
Welcome to Waypoint Mesa, your private desert getaway in the heart of Mesa. This spacious 6-bedroom home sleeps up to 16 guests and is perfect for families, reunions, golf trips, and group getaways.

Enjoy your own backyard resort with a heated pool, hot tub, mini golf, fire pit, covered patio, and outdoor dining. Spend sunny Arizona days by the pool, then unwind together under the desert sky. Plenty of space to relax, play, and make memories.

 The space 
This beautifully curated 6-bedroom, 3.5-bath villa was designed for comfort, style, and fun. Sleeping up to 16 guests, it’s the perfect retreat for families, groups of friends, and spring training fans looking to enjoy Arizona sunshine together. Thoughtfully styled spaces provide a balance of private retreats and inviting gathering areas where memories are made.

🛏️ Bedrooms & Bathrooms

Upstairs you’ll find six bedrooms, including the spacious primary suite. Each room has been carefully arranged to maximize comfort and flexibility for families and groups.

• Primary Suite: King bed, en suite bath with double vanity & walk-in shower
• Bedroom 2: Two twin beds
• Bedroom 3: Queen bed
• Bedroom 4: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds + game console
• Bedroom 5: King bed with dedicated workspace (desk, chair & printer)
• Bedroom 6: Queen bed (downstairs)
• Additional Sleeping Options: Two Twin XL air mattresses are available to comfortably accommodate 2 guests.
• Two additional bathrooms upstairs provide convenience for larger groups—one with a shower/tub combo and another with a walk-in shower. A half bath is located on the main level.

🍽️ Gather & Dine

The heart of the home is the open-concept living, kitchen, and dining area—spacious, inviting, and designed for quality time together.

• Living Room: Comfortable oversized sectional sofa and a 65" Smart TV, perfect for family movie nights or catching the big game.
• Kitchen: Fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, plus rice cooker, air fryer, toaster, coffee maker, and stocked with cookware, utensils, and spices for homemade meals.
• Dining: A large dining table seats 10, and combined with breakfast bar seating, there’s space for everyone to gather. Families with little ones will appreciate the high chair, children’s dinnerware, and cups provided for convenience.

🎱 Indoor Entertainment

For downtime, you’ll find plenty to do without leaving the house. A dedicated game area with a pool table adds fun for both kids and adults, while high-speed WiFi and Smart TVs throughout ensure everyone stays connected and entertained.

🌴 Outdoor Oasis

Step outside to your private Arizona retreat, designed for both play and relaxation.

• Heated pool (Oct–May) & spa for year-round enjoyment
• Private putting green & ping pong table
• Hanging chair, yard games & a firepit with seating
• Covered lanai with lounge area + dining for 8
• BBQ grill for alfresco meals

Whether it’s a family reunion, a sports getaway, or a Scottsdale weekend, Waypoint Mesa is your home base for comfort and connection.

✨ Book your stay today and start your family’s next story at Waypoint Mesa.

 Guest access 
Guests will have full access to the entire home and all amenities, both indoor and outdoor. This includes the fully equipped kitchen, spacious living areas, six bedrooms, and 3.5 bathrooms. 

Outdoors, you’ll enjoy the heated pool (Oct–May), hot tub, private putting green, ping pong table, hanging chair, yard games, firepit with seating, and covered lanai with dining for 8. The BBQ grill and indoor game area with a pool table are also yours to use.

🔑 Check-In & Entry

• The home features keyless entry for a smooth self-check-in, day or night.
• We’ll provide detailed arrival instructions before your stay.

⚙️ Pool Equipment

• Please do not remove or tamper with the pool equipment, as this may cause damage and prevent the pool from staying clean during your stay.

🚗 Parking

• 1 vehicle may park in the garage (note: water heater placement may limit space for longer vehicles).
• Driveway parking available for up to 3 vehicles.

🔒 Safety & Security

• Exterior cameras are located at the front door (covering the porch), garage (covering the driveway), near the pool equipment (covering part of the pool and fire pit), and by the garage back door (covering part of the hot tub). These cameras are motion and audio-activated and used for guest safety only.
• A Minut noise detection device is installed on the lanai/outside (monitors decibel levels only; does not record).
• There are no interior cameras on the property or in any private spaces.

There are no shared spaces — you’ll have complete privacy to enjoy Waypoint Mesa.

 Other things to note 
We want your stay at Waypoint Mesa to be as relaxing, enjoyable, and memorable as possible. To help you plan ahead, here are a few important details:

• Primary Renter: Must be at least 25 years old.
• Peaceful Retreat: Out of respect for our neighbors, no parties or events are permitted.
• Pets & Smoking: Not allowed anywhere on the property.
• Quiet Hours: 10 PM – 7 AM to ensure a restful environment for all.
• Rental Agreement & Guest Verification: All guests are required to sign our Rental Agreement and complete guest verification prior to receiving check-in instructions.
• Guest Verification: For added protection, we partner with a secure third-party platform that completes a quick verification and damage waiver for each reservation. You’ll receive a link after booking. This step takes about 2 minutes and is required to finalize your stay. Your information is encrypted and never shared with us. If you have any questions, please message us prior to booking. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation, as this helps us keep our home well cared for and minimize fees for guests.

Provided Amenities:

• Toaster, microwave, blender, air fryer, rice cooker, cooking essentials, silverware, plates, bowls, glassware
• Drip coffee maker, hot water kettle
• Dishwasher & dishwasher detergent
• Washer, dryer, clothing detergent, iron, ironing board
• Shampoo, conditioner, body wash & hair dryer in each bathroom
• Bed linens, pillows, blankets, bath & pool towels
• Outdoor gas grill (propane provided)
• Pack ’n Play & high chair

Not Provided:

• Condiments, pressure cookers, crockpots, bottled or filtered water
• Speakers or stereo

If you need specific items for your stay, please check in advance so we can confirm availability.
